nodes.label: Client-side cumulative/moving-average/projection math
nodes.rationale: Lives in TypeScript (lib/charts/series-math.ts), not Rust, so a Habit Breakdown metric toggle never needs an IPC round trip; domain::projections' cumulative/moving_average/recent_daily_rate/forward_projection/CumulativePoint were deleted in Phase 4 once the client-side equivalents existed. Deliberate -- do not reintroduce Rust-side without a real reason.

nodes.label: Metric enum kept with 4 variants
nodes.rationale: domain::projections' Metric enum keeps TimeSpent/LifeShortened/TotalTimeLost/Money even though only TotalTimeLost has a live Rust caller today -- it's real domain vocabulary matching the plan's own three-way metric language, not speculative; #[allow(dead_code)] is deliberate, with an explanatory comment.

nodes.label: Widmark BAC/caffeine functions left unreachable
nodes.rationale: Widmark BAC / caffeine decay functions in cost_model.rs are unreachable and #[allow(dead_code)]-marked on purpose -- Habit has no category/kind field so nothing can identify 'this entry is alcohol' to route through them. Don't wire them to a guess; add a real habit-category concept first or leave them be.

nodes.label: pub(crate) hexagonal boundary
nodes.rationale: Db::lock(), infrastructure::db::codec, and similar are pub(crate), not pub -- an intentional hexagonal-architecture boundary: the domain layer never imports rusqlite, only infrastructure adapters do. Keep new SQLite-touching code inside infrastructure/db/.

nodes.label: Stores do full refetch, not fine-grained patching
nodes.rationale: habitsStore, todayStore, timelineStore each subscribe to onDataChanged and do a simple full refetch on change rather than fine-grained patching -- deliberate, see the Phase 4 commit message.

nodes.label: .numbers reader confidence tiers
nodes.rationale: High confidence (verified against real Apple bytes) for Snappy chunk framing, protobuf ArchiveInfo/MessageInfo structure and the IWAObjectType registry. High confidence (ported from a real working parser's algorithm) for cell_storage.rs's per-cell decode, version 5 cell storage only. Lower confidence, explicitly flagged: the TableDataList string-table entry format in numbers/source.rs::read_string_table, since no real populated example was available to check it against -- getting it wrong only loses text cells. No real .numbers fixture files exist in the repo yet.

nodes.label: No visual verification gap (Chrome extension)
nodes.rationale: The claude-in-chrome extension was not connected this entire session, so no chart or UI layout in the app has been visually verified by screenshot -- only by type-checking, unit tests, and a live tauri dev boot check. Flagged as a real gap worth closing if the extension connects in a new session.

nodes.label: Phase 6 - Ledger (continuation detail)
nodes.rationale: Backend is entirely ready; this phase is frontend-only. Needs previewImport/applyImport/exportEntries IPC wrappers, existing CRUD wiring, and the Tauri dialog plugin (@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog) as the one piece of new plumbing.

nodes.label: Phase 7 - Profile + Settings + theme editor (continuation detail)
nodes.rationale: Profile form bound to get_profile/save_profile; Settings needs a new settings concept for startupRoute and other options; theme editor mostly wires already-tested schema/validation/contrast code into a form UI. Theme persistence across restarts doesn't exist yet.

nodes.label: Phase 8 - Polish + README (continuation detail)
nodes.rationale: Motion audit at slow speed, empty/error/loading states, keyboard nav, perf pass, tauri build for installer size/cold-start, and the README per plan-v1.md's README section; also where forced-on prefers-reduced-motion/-transparency/-contrast verification should happen.

nodes.label: @tauri-apps/plugin-dialog
nodes.rationale: Not yet added; file picking for Phase 6 needs this plugin plus the matching tauri-plugin-dialog Rust crate, a .plugin(...) entry in lib.rs, and dialog:allow-open/allow-save capability entries.

nodes.label: Force-scaffold deleted plan-v1.md
nodes.rationale: npm create tauri-app -- . -f (Phase 1 scaffold) force-deleted plan-v1.md by force-scaffolding into a non-empty, uncommitted directory. Recovered verbatim from conversation context; verify with git log --follow plan-v1.md if ever in doubt. Repo is now fully committed so the specific risk is gone.

nodes.label: Theme persistence not yet implemented
nodes.rationale: themeStore defaults to deepCurrent every launch; Phase 3 deliberately deferred persistence. Phase 7 needs a settings table entry (selected theme name or full custom theme JSON) plus loading it in +layout.svelte's onMount before/instead of the hardcoded default.
